model.scope: Owned-file reader/scanner snapshot and epoch controls, separate from canonical tests and real-device acceptance.

reviewed_contracts: Start reset and retry ownership; duplicate start refusal, process/log/lock identity and Popen uncertainty.
Polling and Stop arbitration, observed exit versus accepted signal delivery, conservative liveness and terminal retirement.
Exact launched-method counters/phase/precision; trusted engine records, model continuations, shared status cells and negative evidence.
Bounded file reads, active inode binding, snapshot signatures, complete records, oversized-line refusal and projection provenance.
Monotonic and stale progress, estimate/clock constraints; verified versus completed evidence and advisory checks.
retained_model_history: initial-aligned-* files preserve first all-green model with aligned tails. Final script adds a trailing harmless record, requires 240 cut-head controls and preserves all original success/refusal expectations. This is model strengthening, not a product finding.
limits: Fake/owned-file supporting checks overlap canonical suite; do not add their counts to unique Python coverage.
No actual engine/device/inventory/signal/firmware/power/guest/remote action or native acceptance.
File epoch mutation verifies the large-log reader/scanner contract, not an atomic OS file-system or hardware guarantee.
